activity_summary: After Errors you stood a minute with Kemp and Burbage. The yard had been full at two. You had a speech at each end and a stool between, and you said you were well. The cake at Holywell was next. You did not stay to tell the play over.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered for the tale and the cold, and went.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Named the stool and refused a written silence.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The tale is long, and I have said it since Christmas.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You had a speech at each end and a stool in the middle

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Holywell is after this, and my mother has a cake
